items.html:
The release approval gate cannot be completed while a repository remains private. GitHub allows required reviewers only on public repositories. Creating release alone provides no approval gate. GitHub environment availability

The workflow settings should be:

Setting Required configuration
testpypi, pypi, release environments Selected branches/tags policy; allow branch main only, no tags
release approval, once public Required reviewer yaugenst; Prevent self-review unchecked; disable administrator bypass
github-pages environment Allow branch main only; no reviewer needed
Pages Source GitHub Actions; gh-pages remains Mike’s version-history storage
Trusted publishers yaugenst/treams-rs, workflow publish-release.yml, respective testpypi/pypi environment
Codecov App access to this repository; workflow already requests OIDC

Use explicit selected-branch policies, not “Protected branches only”: GitHub allows every branch through that option when no branch protection exists. Environment policies inspect the triggering workflow’s GITHUB_REF, not the checked-out source SHA. The REST policy can explicitly use {"name":"main","type":"branch"}. Deployment policies, policy API

For minimally sufficient v* protection, use two active tag rulesets, both targeting refs/tags/v*:

  1. Creation: creation rule; bypass only yaugenst.
  2. Immutability: update and deletion rules; empty bypass list. Blocking all updates already blocks force-updates.

One combined ruleset with an owner bypass would also permit that owner to update/delete tags. Separate rulesets preserve creation permission while independently preventing those operations. The owner can still deliberately edit the rulesets themselves. Rule semantics, rule aggregation

Current REST documentation supports bypass actor type User, its numeric ID, and bypass_mode: "always". OrganizationAdmin is explicitly inapplicable to personal repositories; pull-request-only bypass applies only to branch rulesets. Rules API

Other visibility constraints:

  • Tag rulesets and Pages wait until the repository is public. Pages published from a private repository is still public; configuration is not authorization to deploy. Ruleset availability, Pages availability and visibility
  • Private vulnerability reporting is enabled for public repositories, so defer that setting until visibility changes. GitHub vulnerability reporting

Leave main protection unchanged until the rewrite. No repository changes, GitHub mutations, builds, or deployments performed.

The proposed fix passes the requested compatibility checks.

  • uv 0.12.18 and 0.12.19: uv lock --check and the exact CI locked-export command both passed against the updated 95-package lock.
  • virtualenv 21.7.13 fixes the advisory. The previous 21.7.9 was affected; the newest advisory covers versions through 21.7.12. Locally it is a development dependency through pre-commit; exporting all runtime extras without development dependencies contains no virtualenv. Primary advisory
  • The version guard caused the hosted failure. Run 37117485270 used old main’s ==0.12.3 with hosted uv 0.12.18. Integration’s ==0.12.22 would also reject that runner. Dependabot invokes its preinstalled uv and reports its version-constraint rejection. Updater source
  • Keep >=0.12.18,<0.13 for the smallest supported remedy. The pinned setup-uv action accepts this range and selects the highest compatible version. It therefore permits future 0.12.x updates rather than fixing CI to 0.12.22. An exact CI pin requires a separate selection file such as .tool-versions. Pinned action documentation

No source edits, project installations, builds, pushes, or GitHub mutations performed. Hosted Dependabot success remains unverified until the corrected configuration reaches its default branch.
